title: Aurora Commerce
summary: A conceptual storefront exploring catalog browsing, cart state, and checkout flow.
description: A self-initiated concept project exploring the structure of a modern e-commerce experience: product catalog, filtering, cart state, and a multi-step checkout. Built to study state management and UX patterns rather than to serve real transactions.

title: Signal Analytics
summary: A dashboard concept for visualizing time-series metrics and alerts.
description: An experimental analytics dashboard exploring data visualization, responsive chart layouts, and alert affordances. Focused on information density and readability rather than production data pipelines.

title: Forge API
summary: A personal REST API experiment with auth and resource endpoints.
description: A personal backend experiment implementing a small REST API with authentication, validation, and resource CRUD. Used to refine API design, error handling, and documentation habits.

title: Atlas Docs
summary: A documentation site concept with search and structured navigation.
description: A concept documentation experience exploring sidebar navigation, full-text search, and code block presentation. Aimed at improving developer-facing readability.

title: Pulse Monitor
description: A personal experiment in health-check polling and status presentation. Explores lightweight monitoring concepts and clear status communication.

title: Nimbus Studio
summary: A landing-page concept for a creative studio.
description: A self-initiated landing page concept exploring hero composition, motion, and brand presentation for a fictional creative studio. Design exercise only.
